units.source_text: 古歌：“筑波山内丛林密，不阻真心欲入人。”

en.t: An old poem says, "The groves on Mount Tsukuba are dense, yet they do not bar one who truly wishes to enter."
It appears in the Shin Kokin Wakashu.
Mount Tsukuba is in Hitachi Province.

units.source_text: 此文意思是说：虽欲寻访常陆守的养女，但真个向她求爱，有所未便。

en.t: The meaning of this passage is that although he wished to seek out the daughter adopted by the governor of Hitachi, it would be somewhat inconvenient actually to court her.
